query:
The Harrington family operates with a norm that Sunday evening is family chat time — everyone checks in at least once over the weekend. Based on the conversations, does this hold equally for all family members — or does someone consistently relate to it differently, and what tells you that?

Options:
A. Marcus
B. Luis
C. Rob
D. Jess
context:
[1] (about=Luis, episodic, t6 @2026-01-27T20:15:00) Marcus running a Harrington game night via calendar invite is somehow the most satisfying development of 2026 so far. I'm in, even if I have to video-in too. This is what family should feel like! Also Jess wants me to tell everyone her thighs are still sore 😂
[2] (about=Jess, episodic, t10 @2026-02-10T19:17:00) Luis has been saying this for a year actually and I kept saying flights are expensive but I think he's right. The kids were shy with Dad on that tablet call at first. That was a flag. Let me look at October, we might be able to do a long weekend around Columbus Day.
[3] (about=Luis, episodic, t10 @2026-02-10T19:15:00) Carol okay I have to be honest, that hit me harder than I expected. My mom said something similar last month. I've been thinking -- one Columbus trip a year isn't enough anymore. The kids are at the age where they need the grandparents in the room, not just on a screen. I want to talk about doing a second trip this year. Summer is obvious but what about fall too? I can work around the restaurant schedule.
[4] (about=Luis, episodic, t14 @2026-02-24T19:35:00) Priya that is the best thing I've read in this chat since the pregnancy announcement and that was pretty good. Also just want to say -- watching Rob, Dana, and Marcus all run interference on Carol's guest list in real time is genuinely beautiful sibling choreography. You three have finally become a unit. 😂
[5] (about=Rob, episodic, t12 @2026-02-17T19:29:00) I want to say something here. I've always been against extended family stays, you all know that, too many people in the house for too long is not my thing. But the last few weeks with Priya having a rough time and it just being the two of us has made me think differently. I think we should talk about being closer to family before the baby arrives. Not moving, but more actual time. Longer visits, both directions. R
[6] (about=Rob, episodic, t6 @2026-01-27T20:09:00) Can't make it if it's before February 12, Priya has her 20-week scan on the 10th and we're staying close to home that week. After that we're free most Saturdays. What are you thinking, Marcus?
[7] (about=Marcus, episodic, t6 @2026-01-27T20:12:00) Priya I would genuinely prefer you both in on video. The game runs fine with remote players, I've done it before. Actually it's good practice because once the baby arrives you'll want options that don't require driving. Let's say February 22nd, 3pm. I'll send a proper calendar invite. Rob, does that work around the scan?
[8] (about=Dennis, episodic, t6 @2026-01-27T20:06:00) Depends on the Saturday.
[9] (about=Marcus, episodic, t6 @2026-01-27T20:04:00) Tyler I promise you will leave understanding it. I've run this teach three times now. I actually enjoy the setup more than most people enjoy playing, to be honest. The rules are half the fun. Dad, are you and Mom interested? I can do a Saturday afternoon so it's not a late night.
[10] (about=Marcus, episodic, t13 @2026-02-24T19:15:00) Game night report: Saturday went well. Tyler beat everyone at Wingspan despite claiming not to understand the engine-building mechanic, which I refuse to accept was genuine. Mom and Dad stayed until 6pm which is a record. Dana brought the wine and left before cleanup, which is also a record but in a different direction. To be fair, everyone seemed to actually enjoy it.
[11] (about=Carol, core, t4 @2026-01-20T19:32:00) Carol resists being signed up like a child but agrees to look at the class this week, reiterating she's never needed outside friends.
[12] (about=Dana, episodic, t4 @2026-01-20T19:36:00) mom 'i have my shows' is not a social life...
[13] (about=Jess, episodic, t12 @2026-02-17T19:35:00) Rob that's a genuinely big thing to say and I think it's the right call. Priya I'm sorry it's been hard. You don't have to keep saying you're fine when you're not, that's what the chat is for. Or at least, that's what it should be.
[14] (about=Luis, episodic, t0 @2026-01-06T19:49:00) Carol I keep telling everyone the secret to a good family gathering is the food being actually made with your hands, not ordered in a box. Nobody who eats your casserole goes home sad. That's just facts! 🙌
[15] (about=Marcus, episodic, t4 @2026-01-20T19:58:00) Tyler, yes, I've seen it. The parking lot displaces sixteen bike spaces for a facility that will be used by twenty percent of the population. But also, Mom, I think you'd actually enjoy a class. The social architecture of small groups is different from family. Less history. You might find it easier.
